dslRule:
<!id: lambda-to-instance-method-reference>
<!description: Replace a simple lambda expression forwarding its single argument to an instance method call with a method reference.>
<!severity: HINT>
$listenerObject.$methodCall($param -> $target.$targetMethod($param))
=>
$listenerObject.$methodCall($target::$targetMethod)
;;
summary: Convert a simple lambda `arg -> target.method(arg)` to a method reference `target::method`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
